note: E1; E4; E8-E10: the FY2024 report applies the GRI Standards and carries a GRI content index (GRI 2 and GRI 3 2021), so the reporting practice is shown running; E11-E13 continue it in 2025. Caveat: E6 says climate-related topics are reported 'with reference to' GRI, not 'in accordance'.

E4-E5: GHG emission intensity 0.09 tCO2/S$'000 revenue in FY2025 against 0.09 restated for FY2024 (the trailing 4 is the restatement footnote marker), so the ratio was maintained; total emissions also fell 11,649 to 10,988. E7's FY2026 renewal does not alter this.

E11: the FY2025 report gives an 11% Scope 1+2 reduction against a 2023 base year, while the 2021 promise's baseline is not extracted and the 15%-by-2025 target is never mentioned after 2021; E6, E8, E10 show the goals rebased to 2023 with 2030 deadlines (42%). The figure cannot be read as this target's verdict.

E14 (2024 report): all ThaiBev factories in Thailand completed the Water Sustainability Assessment for surface and groundwater; same reading the group took for P00755. Deadline-year evidence E3-E11 covers water-stress screening and footprint certification, not WSA completion, and E14 does not date completion to 2023.
E2-E3: FY2024 electricity consumption per square foot was 68.0, 'a slight increase from FY2023', and the report itself marks the target as 'Requires improvement'.
E3: the Manager achieved an average of 41 training hours per employee in FY2024, above the 26-hour target; E10 (FY2025: 55 hours) is a later year.

E7: FY2024 achievement 30.0% of new suppliers screened on environmental criteria against the >=5% target; the 4.6% FY2023 figure in E7 matches the promise fragment and confirms the extracted metric. E6: 77 new suppliers assessed.

E12 (2024 report): all ThaiBev factories in Thailand completed the Water Sustainability Assessment for surface and groundwater; same reading the group took for P00755. Deadline-year evidence (E10 water-stress screening of 53 factories, E11 water intensity) does not report WSA completion, and E12 does not date completion to 2023.

E11 (2024 report) lists 'replaced conventional lights with more energy efficient LED lamps' among energy practices without saying all fixtures were replaced or by when; deadline-year E6-E7 speak of Phase 2 of an unnamed project. The LED subject is touched but 100% replacement by 2023 is not settled.

E2-E3: the FY2025 report gives only the cumulative installed capacity (87.51 MWp) across five countries and all years, with no 2025-installed figure for Thailand and Malaysia against 21.83 MWp; E5-E6 set a new 2026 plan (12.84 MWp, Thailand and Vietnam), which tells nothing about 2025.

E8 says the energy target (specified in E4/E10 as 10% energy intensity reduction from 2020) 'was not achieved on time', while E12 reports a 19% decrease in total energy use since 2020 and E8 a 22.5% cut in non-renewable energy intensity. The promise names neither intensity nor a quantity, so it is not resolvable which verdict applies; group took the same stance on P00529.

E3: no non-compliance with environmental laws and no significant fines or non-monetary sanctions in FY2022 (FY2021: Nil); E8 confirms no reported environmental non-compliance in FY2022. E5 renews the target for FY2023.
E5: no substantiated complaints concerning breaches of customer privacy or losses of customer data in FY2023; E1 highlights 'no cases' of such breaches. E6 is the FY2024 renewal.

E11-E12: in the 2025 report the EMG (Taiping) project still recycles about 110 m3 per day, the same as in 2022 (E1-E2) and 2024 (E4), far below the 3,000 m3/day target, and the goal is softened to 'increase the daily recycling rate gradually'. E1-E2 tie the 3,000 target to this project.

The antecedent of 'this track record' is not given in the promise or extraction. E6-E7 (2022 report p.15, same page as the promise) report no non-compliance with laws resulting in significant fines in FY2022, but E2 (zero corruption), E8 (no discrimination) and E9 (accident frequency target missed) are other candidate track records; cannot fix the referent, as the group found for P00465.
